{
  "version": "1.70.73",
  "updatedAt": "2026-08-31",
  "standards": [
    {
      "id": "ui.base-components.first",
      "title": "Base Components First",
      "value": "whenever building UI, use the shared primitives demonstrated on the Base Components page (/studio/base-components, pageKey base-components, catalog src/features/base-components/); do not invent custom base controls, raw HTML form inputs/checkboxes/textareas, or ad-hoc HeroUI markup when a catalogued section exists; match the living sample for that section (component, props, sizes, intents, chrome); Base Components is the visual source of truth — remaining projectStandards entries and topic shards are implementation detail for those primitives",
      "appliesTo": [
        "all new UI work",
        "forms",
        "dialogs",
        "toolbars",
        "grids",
        "buttons",
        "Base Components"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.where-builder",
      "title": "Where Builder for Nested Predicates",
      "value": "nested AND/OR field/operator/value predicates use UiWhereBuilder from Base Components → where-builder; combinator is a segmented AND/OR on the group header (not on every child row, not a tree grid); field and operator are UiSelectMenu dropdowns; value widgets follow field type; optional contextItems adds a trailing dropdown on text value slots only that writes a server-context expression; a condition or nested group may switch once to a manual expression with no switch-back (delete only); allowReorder shows a grip handle to drag a node among siblings or into another group",
      "appliesTo": [
        "filters",
        "query criteria",
        "record scope",
        "predicate editors",
        "Base Components"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.visual.semantic-color-restraint",
      "title": "Semantic Color — Subtle and Small-Area",
      "value": "use gentle, concept-matched color to aid scanning — not decoration; prefer color on text, icons, badges, pills, and other small objects; keep large surfaces white/neutral slate (page shell #F8FAFC, cards #FFFFFF, sidebar/header un-tinted, modal body, grid host); never paint chrome from the operator accent; status badges use fixed emerald #10B981 / amber #F59E0B / red #EF4444 and must not follow Cranberry or Gray; reuse existing semantic maps (buttonSemantics.ts, ICON_ACTION_*_CLASS, APP_SURFACE_BOX_TONE_CLASS, grid action colors) — no ad-hoc palette entries; one or two accent hues per view is enough",
      "appliesTo": [
        "all pages",
        "forms",
        "panels",
        "labels",
        "badges",
        "icons",
        "status text"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-design-system"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.form.field.hint.heroui-tooltip",
      "title": "Field Hints Use HeroUI Tooltip Only",
      "value": "operator field/label hints must use FieldHintTooltip (HeroUI Tooltip + info icon) via FormField hint prop or Settings labelInfo / SettingsNavScopeHint; never ordinary under-field helper paragraphs (e.g. text-[10px] text-slate-400), native title= attribute hints, or ad-hoc hint chrome; placeholders are for input examples only; dense grid ActionTooltip native title remains the sole performance exception; FormField/FormSection hint also feeds the page guide; see docs/standards/ui-core.md §Page guide",
      "appliesTo": [
        "FormField",
        "FieldHintTooltip",
        "SettingsNavScopeHint",
        "labelInfo",
        "forms",
        "hints",
        "tooltips",
        "page guide"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.page-guide.hints",
      "title": "Page Guide Title And Hint On Explainable Controls",
      "value": "the studio tour guide walks [data-page-guide] stops that have both title and hint; page content (toolbars, create, paging, dialogs, FormField/FormSection, designer, Data Studio) is first and shell header/sidebar chrome is last; skip Home nav and studio logo chrome; FormField hint, FormSection hint or description, FieldHintTooltip, Settings labelInfo, and PageHeaderToolbar description are auto-stops; AppButton intent=create, AppSplitButton intent=create, ToolbarSearchInput, ToolbarRefreshButton, ToolbarFilterRadioGroup, ToolbarFilterSelect, ToolbarFilterCheckbox, ToolbarFilterMatchLogicBadge, GridPagingFooter, and AppSearchBox are local page stops; generators and designer auto-CRUD must emit a plain-language hint on every generated field; a Compass Tour guide header control next to feedback opens the tour (hidden on phone); the tour does not switch to AppEndO chat; click the companion to cycle body shapes; drag it and release to hop it back under the bubble; the active hotspot stays visible and the bubble/companion do not cover it; bubble play/previous/next/done/close are ghost icon-only ICON_ACTION buttons with no visible labels; play shows a cyan circular countdown for the 8-second autoplay interval; hotspot dots swallow pointer events so the control underneath does not activate; do not invent filler hints on every existing field or unlabeled nav item; see docs/standards/ui-core.md §Page guide",
      "appliesTo": [
        "page guide",
        "FormField",
        "FormSection",
        "PageHeaderToolbar",
        "Component Designer",
        "auto CRUD",
        "generated UI"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.form.field.pair-grid",
      "title": "Form Field Pair Grid",
      "value": "pair related short fields (name + select, semver + slug, side-by-side choice boxes) with resolveFormFieldPairGridClass from src/shared/ui/formChoiceLayout.ts — grid grid-cols-1 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2 sm:gap-x-4 sm:items-stretch when both columns visible; single column when only one field; full-width textarea/notes below the grid not inside it; reference Sandbox text-fields Identity and Choice Behavior sections",
      "appliesTo": [
        "FormField",
        "FormSection",
        "create/edit forms",
        "wizards",
        "settings forms"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.form.choice.boxed-list",
      "title": "Boxed Checkbox/Radio Choice Lists",
      "value": "multi-option checkbox or radio lists inside FormSection use UiCheckboxChoiceList / UiRadioChoiceList (src/shared/ui/FormChoiceFields.tsx) with resolveChoiceBoxShellClass chrome — no field label above the box; pair side-by-side with resolveFormFieldPairGridClass(true); exclusive title+description options use option cards (ui.form.choice.option-cards) instead; reference Sandbox Choice Behavior section",
      "appliesTo": [
        "checkbox",
        "radio",
        "UiCheckbox",
        "UiRadioGroup",
        "form fields",
        "FormSection"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.form.choice.option-cards",
      "title": "Exclusive Option Cards (No Radio Dots)",
      "value": "when each exclusive option has a title plus description (mode/policy/encryption pickers, not a short label list), render UiOptionCardGroup (src/shared/ui/UiOptionCardGroup.tsx): one bordered button/box per option (two options → columns=2, three → columns=3, long stacks → columns=1, short name chips that hug their label → columns=auto) with no visible radio — not UiRadioChoiceList, not HeroUI Radio, do not revive a radio-card wrapper; host role=radiogroup, each button role=radio aria-checked; selected state is accent border+light fill; optional per-option tone (AppSurfaceBoxTone) tints border/icon/title at rest and the selected wash — group accentClassName is the fallback; descriptions wrap (whitespace-pre-line); optional Lucide icon sits in the title row (inline-flex items-center gap-1.5, h-3.5 w-3.5 compact / h-4 w-4 default) never a separate chip; field label stays above the grid; living sample Base Components → Choice; product wrapper SmtpEncryptionField; see docs/standards/ui-core.md §Exclusive option cards",
      "appliesTo": [
        "option cards",
        "UiOptionCardGroup",
        "encryption",
        "mode pickers",
        "policy pickers",
        "SmtpEncryptionField",
        "settings forms",
        "wizards",
        "form fields",
        "Base Components"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.form.ai-assist.label-extra-alignment",
      "title": "EUA AiAssist Label Row Alignment",
      "value": "when AiAssistFormField (context-suggest labelExtra) sits beside a plain FormField in a two-column pair grid, pass labelExtra with AI_FIELD_LABEL_EXTRA_PLACEHOLDER_CLASS (inline-block h-3 w-3 shrink-0) on the plain field to reserve the sparkle icon slot; wrap sections using AiFieldAssistSectionProvider; section-level structured extract via AiStructuredExtractLauncher in the form header toolbar row; reference Sandbox AI assist",
      "appliesTo": [
        "AiAssistFormField",
        "FormField",
        "eua",
        "form fields",
        "create/edit forms"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.form.section.write",
      "title": "How To Write Form Sections",
      "value": "author create/edit and wizard groups with FormSection only — gold sample Portals → Edit portal (PortalsPageView + PortalBrandFields); pass a short sentence-case English title (Portal, Identity, Redirect, Layout) — FormSection CSS-uppercases and draws the ink bar; never hand-roll h2/h3 headers, pre-uppercased titles, or under-heading helper paragraphs; first section omits divided, every later section sets divided; stack groups with flex flex-col gap-1; dense create/edit uses hint (info icon) not description; pair short fields with resolveFormFieldPairGridClass(true) and put full-width textarea below; set ink and rotate accent / complement / contrast so neighbors differ (accent = record identity, complement = related brand/chrome, contrast = policy/routing); nested FormField labels inherit ink; Enabled / System Protected stay on the dialog top band, not a FormSection; Settings uses SettingsFormGroup instead; see docs/standards/ui-core.md §Form sections",
      "appliesTo": [
        "FormSection",
        "FormField",
        "create/edit forms",
        "wizards",
        "modal forms",
        "PortalsPageView",
        "PortalBrandFields"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.dialog.footers",
      "title": "Dialog Footers",
      "value": "multiple footers allowed; footer surface uses DIALOG_FOOTER_SURFACE_BG_CLASS (bg-slate-100/90) via surface chrome footer tokens or DIALOG_ACTION_FOOTER_CLASS / DIALOG_AUXILIARY_FOOTER_CLASS / CREATE_EDIT_MODAL_FOOTER_CLASS / STEP_WIZARD_FOOTER_CLASS / GRID_PAGING_FOOTER_CLASS; ActionFooter (DIALOG_ACTION_FOOTER_CLASS) must be last with primary actions (AppButton size=sm, justify-end); AuxiliaryFooter (DIALOG_AUXILIARY_FOOTER_CLASS) for metadata or wizard navigation (justify-between allowed)",
      "appliesTo": [
        "dialog footers",
        "modal footers",
        "DialogFooter"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-dialog"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.inspector-rail.kv-grid",
      "title": "Inspector Rail Label/Value Grid",
      "value": "inspector KV rows use INSPECTOR_RAIL_KV_CLASS (grid-cols-3 items-start); label INSPECTOR_RAIL_LABEL_CLASS and value INSPECTOR_RAIL_VALUE_CLASS are min-h-8 items-center so they share a horizontal midline; never justify-between, pt-0.5 on the label, or far-right values; display strings use DirectionalText; see docs/standards/ui-inspector-rail.md",
      "appliesTo": [
        "inspector rail",
        "side panel",
        "MetaField",
        "label value"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-inspector-rail"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.form.access-control.modal",
      "title": "Access Control Modal",
      "value": "all operator-facing access editors (server functions, platform portals, MCP servers, and future resources) must use AccessControlModal (src/shared/ui/AccessControlModal.tsx) with FunctionAccessControl (src/shared/api/contracts/server-functions/accessControl.ts); do not build parallel access UIs; shell is CreateEditModalShell size=maximized with UiOptionCardGroup mode cards in header subtitle and four allow/deny columns in body; entity pickers via AccessEntityPickerDialog; PlatformRouteBindingAuth is FunctionAccessControl; parsePlatformRouteBindingAuth accepts FunctionAccessControl or null; every AccessControlModal opener uses AccessControlActionIcon (KeyRound) from src/shared/ui/accessControlAction.tsx and GRID_ACTION_ACCESS_CLASS (text-cyan-600 hover:bg-cyan-50) in grid actions — never Shield/Lock; reference ServerFunctionsPageView.tsx, PortalAccessModal.tsx, McpServersSection.tsx",
      "appliesTo": [
        "access modals",
        "server function access",
        "application access",
        "mcp server access",
        "route binding access"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-dialog"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.wizard.step-indicators",
      "title": "Step Wizard Step Indicator Band",
      "value": "step indicator band uses STEP_WIZARD_STEPS_HEADER_CLASS with one equal-width grid cell per step; each cell shows optional Lucide icon plus truncated title (text-[11px] font-semibold); stepTabColor default theme uses --app-accent-* washes on selected and unselected cells, with titles and step icons in darkened theme ink (--app-nav-group-header-text / STEP_WIZARD_HEADER_TITLE_INK_CLASS) rather than bright --app-accent-700; wizard dialog title uses the same ink (STEP_WIZARD_HEADER_TITLE_TEXT_CLASS); gray keeps slate/nav cells (active bg-primary-subtle text-primary-700); custom passes { selected, unselected } hexes with darkened ink (accent-700 mixed 64% toward black); completed steps use bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 (icon text-emerald-600) only when that recipe is applied; upcoming gray steps use text-text-nav (icon text-text-nav-icon); description band (header 3) uses STEP_WIZARD_DESCRIPTION_CLASS — darker slate veil (STEP_WIZARD_DESCRIPTION_SURFACE_CLASS), not chrome.headerBand and no tram/pattern; active step icon tile and description copy",
      "appliesTo": [
        "step wizards",
        "wizard step headers",
        "wizard step descriptions"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-dialog"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.wizard.validation-and-state",
      "title": "Step Wizard Validation and State",
      "value": "block step advancement with onNext returning false after per-step validation; show validation errors at top of step body in rose banner (rounded-md border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-rose-700); reset wizard state (step index, fields, errors) when modal opens; wire onBackdropClick to close handler; tree/grid-heavy steps may pass bodyInnerClassName !overflow-hidden flex flex-col min-h-0 for nested scroll inside fixed shell height",
      "appliesTo": [
        "step wizards",
        "wizard validation",
        "wizard state reset"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-dialog"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.form.settings.label-info-placement",
      "title": "Settings Label Info Icon Placement",
      "value": "Settings label/title info tooltips use shared FieldHintTooltip via SettingsNavScopeHint: icon must sit immediately after the label text in an inline-flex row with gap-0.5 — use SettingsLabelInfoRow or labelInfo/titleInfo on SettingsField, SettingsToggleField, and SettingsFormGroup; never use flex-1 on the label to push the icon to the far edge; reserve a fixed 16×16 icon slot (reserveInfoSlot, default true) when sibling fields mix with/without labelInfo; default labelBand on SettingsField wraps label rows in SETTINGS_FIELD_LABEL_BAND_CLASS (min-h-8) for grid alignment — pass labelBand={false} on full-width fields stacked below grids; reference SettingsFormPrimitives.tsx and ui-core.md §Field & label hints",
      "appliesTo": [
        "settings forms",
        "SettingsField",
        "SettingsToggleField",
        "SettingsFormGroup",
        "SettingsLabelInfoRow",
        "SettingsNavScopeHint"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.form.settings.section-spacing",
      "title": "Settings Section and Field Spacing",
      "value": "Settings config forms: inter-section spacing via SettingsFormGroup divided (FORM_SECTION_DIVIDED_CLASS / pt-3); stack fields inside one section with SETTINGS_FORM_GROUP_BODY_STACK_CLASS (space-y-2); multi-column rows use SETTINGS_FORM_GRID_GAP_CLASS (gap-2); label-to-control stays gap-[2px]; never apply space-y-* or gap-* stack utilities directly on fieldset — use SettingsDisabledFieldset which wraps children in an inner div; full-width fields below grids (Description, Message textarea, etc.) use SettingsField labelBand={false}; reference PwaSettingsSection.tsx and docs/standards/ui-core.md",
      "appliesTo": [
        "settings forms",
        "SettingsFormGroup",
        "SettingsField",
        "SettingsDisabledFieldset",
        "PwaSettingsSection",
        "config forms"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-core"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.form.flat-sections-no-boxes",
      "title": "Flat Form Sections (No Panel Boxes)",
      "value": "wizard, create/edit modal, and Settings config field grouping must use flat FormSection + FormField (src/shared/ui/FormSection.tsx) or SettingsFormGroup (src/features/settings/components/form/SettingsFormPrimitives.tsx): accent bar, uppercase section title tinted by tone, optional description and headerExtra, divided prop for top spacing (FORM_SECTION_DIVIDED_CLASS / pt-3) on every group after the first — no horizontal border lines between sections; intra-section field stack uses SETTINGS_FORM_GROUP_BODY_STACK_CLASS (space-y-2); Settings typography and subtle semantic color via getSettingsTypography(sectionId) in settingsSectionTypography.ts (page title, field labels, toggles, checkbox cards, grid lines) — content tints are darker than the Settings nav of the same hue (nav icons stay *-600; content uses *-900–*-950; do not darken submenu/selection); do not wrap form subsections in rounded-md border bg-white/slate panel boxes or per-row tinted cards — **exception:** boxed multi-choice checkbox/radio lists (UI_CHOICE_BOX_SHELL_CLASS in formChoiceLayout.ts), exclusive option-card boxes (SmtpEncryptionField) inside FormSection bodies, and read-only nested-editor inspector cards (docs/standards/ui-inspector-rail.md); AppSurfaceBox is for workspace/tool panels, not arbitrary wizard or settings form sections; bordered shells remain allowed for data hosts (grids, selection tables, AppTableGrid); reference UserCreateWizardModal.tsx, AuthSettingsFields.tsx, PackageBuilderModal.tsx, Sandbox form-fields, docs/standards/ui-core.md §Form field layout, docs/standards/ui-dialog.md",
      "appliesTo": [
        "step wizards",
        "create forms",
        "edit forms",
        "modal forms",
        "FormSection",
        "settings forms",
        "SettingsFormGroup"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-dialog"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.dialog.flex-growing-body",
      "title": "Create/Edit Modal Flex-Growing Body Host",
      "value": "when a create/edit modal body must stretch a checklist/grid/list to the footer, wire the full flex chain: shellClassName flex min-h-[min(<px>,72vh)] flex-col overflow-hidden (or size=maximized); bodyClassName flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col overflow-hidden !min-h-0; fixed bands shrink-0; growing section via FormSection className flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col; scroll only inside bordered data host (flex min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-hidden rounded-lg border + inner overflow-y-auto); do not use AppSurfaceBox fill inside CreateEditModalShell without this chain; do not duplicate section titles (AppSurfaceBox title + inner editor header); checkbox lists use flex flex-wrap gap-2 not fixed grid-cols-3; reference ConfigureDataApiDialog.tsx, docs/standards/ui-dialog.md",
      "appliesTo": [
        "CreateEditModalShell",
        "configure dialogs",
        "modal checklist hosts",
        "FormSection",
        "AppSurfaceBox fill"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-dialog"
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.icon-action.ghost-only",
      "title": "Ghost Icon Action Buttons",
      "value": "for non-grid icon action buttons (floating row actions, inline input actions, compact tool controls), use ghost icon-only buttons with no border or filled background at rest; reuse ICON_ACTION_*_CLASS from src/shared/ui/surfaceClasses.ts",
      "appliesTo": [
        "floating row actions",
        "inline input actions",
        "compact tool controls",
        "rename input actions"
      ],
      "shard": "ui-toolbar"
    }
  ],
  "matchCount": 84,
  "truncated": true,
  "maxRules": 20,
  "knowledgeKinds": [
    "STANDARD",
    "BUILDER_GUIDANCE",
    "ANTI_PATTERN"
  ],
  "agentsMdPointer": "See AGENTS.md hub and docs/standards/INDEX.md for topic shards.",
  "runtimeApi": "/api/project-standards",
  "shardHint": "Pass shard (e.g. ui-grid) to load the full markdown topic file."
}
